title: Notion for corporate recruiters on mac: how to manage candidates and intake notes
metaTitle: Notion for corporate recruiters on mac: manage hiring pipelines
description: Learn how to use Notion for corporate recruiters on mac to track candidates, organize intake notes, and reduce administrative overhead with Lazur.
targetKeyword: notion for corporate recruiters on mac
intro: Using Notion for corporate recruiters on mac helps you centralize candidate data and reduce the time you spend on manual administrative tasks. By combining the Notion desktop app with Lazur, you can quickly capture intake notes, manage interview scorecards, and navigate complex pipelines without leaving your keyboard.
tldr: Use Notion databases to track candidate status and interview stages.
Master keyboard shortcuts to move faster across your workspace.
Use Lazur to dictate notes and ask questions about your screen.
Keep your workspace clean to avoid tab chaos and data loss.
Automate repetitive formatting with templates and database properties.

blocks.text: Setting up your recruiting workspace in Notion

Start by creating a master database for your candidates. Open the Notion desktop app on your Mac. Press ⌘ N to create a new page. Type /database and select Database - Full page. Name it Hiring Pipeline. This structure allows you to add properties like Status, Interview Date, and Recruiter Notes.

items: Use the Status property to track candidates from Sourcing to Offer.
Add a Date property for interview scheduling.
Use a Person property to assign roles to your team members.
Create a template for interview scorecards to keep feedback consistent.

blocks.text: Speeding up your workflow with Mac shortcuts

Efficiency on a Mac comes down to keeping your hands on the keyboard. Notion supports standard macOS shortcuts. Use ⌘ P to open the search bar and jump to any candidate page instantly. If you need to see all your shortcuts, press ⇧ ? in the app.
If you feel lost in a deep hierarchy, use the sidebar to drag and drop pages into a Favorites section. This keeps your active searches at the top of your view.
blocks.title: Keep your workspace tidy

blocks.text: Using Lazur to manage recruiting tasks

Lazur sits in your Mac notch and helps you stay focused. Hold ⌥ ⌘ to ask about anything on your screen. If you are looking at a candidate profile and forget where the contact field is, ask Lazur. It will circle the element for you.
Common mistakes when using Notion for recruiting

Many recruiters clutter their workspace with too many sub-pages. This makes searching harder. Stick to one master database and use views to filter by job role or status. Avoid manual formatting for every candidate. Use database templates to pre-fill your interview questions and evaluation criteria.

items: Filter your database view to show only candidates in the current hiring stage.
Use the Group by feature to organize candidates by their current step in the pipeline.
Add a formula property to calculate days since the last contact.
Export your candidate list to CSV if you need to share it with stakeholders outside your workspace.

blocks.text: Scheduling is often the biggest time sink for recruiters. While Notion is great for notes, link your calendar to it. Create a link to your booking tool in a template. When you talk to a candidate, you can quickly copy that link and paste it into your message.

Recruiting involves sensitive personal information. Use the Lock page feature in Notion to prevent accidental edits to your master pipeline. You can find this in the top right menu of any page. Only share specific views with team members who need access to candidate details.

Productivity is about removing friction from your daily tasks. Use Notion to store your processes and Lazur to handle the quick questions that pop up during your day. By reducing the time you spend searching for information, you can focus on building relationships with your candidates.

faq.question: Can I use Notion for recruiting on an older Mac?
faq.answer: The Notion desktop app requires macOS 13 or later. If your Mac cannot run this version, you can use the web version in Chrome or Safari.

faq.question: How do I speed up my data entry in Notion?
faq.answer: Use database templates to create standard structures for every candidate. Hold fn to use Lazur's dictation to fill out notes quickly.

faq.question: Does Lazur edit my Notion database for me?
faq.answer: No. Lazur does not click buttons or edit files. It helps you by pointing at items, answering your questions, and dictating text at your cursor.

faq.question: Is it safe to store candidate info in Notion?
faq.answer: Notion provides security features like page locking and granular permissions. Ensure your workspace settings align with your company's data privacy policies.

faq.question: How do I find a specific candidate in a large database?
faq.answer: Use the filter icon at the top of your database to search by name or status. You can also use ⌘ P to search across your entire workspace.
